analyst_view.overall: Two struggling sides meet in Guimarães on Saturday night: Tiago Margarido's Vitória (14th, 9 points) are three games without a win and went out of the cup 0-2 at home to Braga, while Estrela (12th, 10 points) have lost five league games in a row but won their first game under new coach Pepa, 1-0 at Portimonense in the cup, with their first clean sheet in 13 games. Pepa returns to a club he used to coach. Vitória's defence is hit: centre-back Toni Borevkovic is suspended after his fifth booking and left-back João Mendes has torn a cruciate ligament, so with Francisco Dias also out a youth player (Kebdani or 18-year-old Tomás Rodrigues) is likely at left-back and Thiago Balieiro at centre-back; the numbers list Dias but not Borevkovic or Mendes. For Estrela, Arévalo is doubtful (in the numbers) and Sports Mole says Eddy Doué and Béni Souza have been left out lately for disciplinary reasons and are doubts. Cláudio Pereira referees, with his record (5.7 cards a game in 3 games) already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.7 for Vitória and 0.9 for Estrela. Vitória's back line has lost Borevkovic (suspended) and João Mendes (season over), neither of which the numbers know, so a new centre-back and an untested youth left-back should give Estrela's attack, led by five-goal Antonetti, a little more. Estrela's tighter start under Pepa and the doubts over Doué and Béni keep the lean small: about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 5.9 for Vitória. As the home side needing a win Vitória should push forward, but with a youth player at left-back they may get less from that flank; both sides' recent corner counts are close to normal and already in the numbers, so I stay at about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.0 cards, already adding 2.6% for Cláudio Pereira's record and taking a little off because Estrela have been booked less than usual lately. Vitória are under pressure and Pepa's return adds some edge, but they lose Borevkovic, already on five bookings, and nothing points clearly beyond what the numbers count, so I stay at 5.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots, 14.9 for Vitória. Vitória had one shot in the first half against Braga but pressed hard after the break, and Estrela have been shooting more than expected lately, which the numbers already count (+8.1%). The defensive changes matter more for goals than for the shot count, so I stay at about 24.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.6 shots on target, 4.8 for Vitória. Estrela's accuracy has dropped during their losing run and the numbers already trim them for it; Vitória's makeshift defence could give Estrela a little more, but I have put that on goals and do not count it twice, so I stay at about 7.6.
